description: ZESFEM crystallizes in the tetragonal crystal system with space group P 42/n. Reported CIF formula moiety: C88 H100 Dy4 N16 O28 S4,2(C2 H6 O1). From the CIF bond table, Dy1 (Dy) has 7 O neighbors; Dy2 (Dy) has 7 O neighbors; Dy3 (Dy) has 7 O neighbors; Dy4 (Dy) has 7 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 2 pairs, 2 components; largest component is a chain with insufficient metal sites for a 3D shape classification. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 3.743-3.743 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 107.82-108.61°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula [Dy4(L3)4(OAc)4]·C2H5OH·H2O (H3L3 = 2-(((5-amino-1,3,4-thiadiazol-2-yl)amino)((3-ethoxy-2-hydroxybenzyl)oxy)methyl)-6-ethoxyphenol). Explicit grouped units in the article formula/name: 4 OAc (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 4 OAc (explicit grouped unit in article compound name (structural notation)).
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.
